simulator.note: Boots as the M3602 family with device.chipId 0x3603 (C3603): the bootloader at 0x000000 (whose chunk header has next = 0, followed at length + 0x80 = 0x020000 by maincode; chips/base.py:chunk_chain) reads the 8 MB flash via SPI quad I/O read 0xEB, unpacks the 8.0 MB maincode into RAM and starts it.  The application starts the SEE co-processor ("M3606 SEE"), initialises the S3501 demodulator at I2C 0x33, and renders its 32-bpp ARGB8888 OSD (8 GE commands, 10 unique colours; without the board's encrypted anti-clone security IC at SCB I2C 0x10 it displays "SW is not designed for this HW, please change back to official SW! -----0a010800 00000000") by 140 M instructions.  Its 39-key remote table (0x99xx) uses the "necfirst" coding.

desc: Edision Argus Miniplus Highspeed official HD firmware 1.5.87 (2013-11-12) for the ALi M3606 / C3603 DVB-S2 satellite receiver on an 8 MB SPI flash.

Sibling of the Edision Optimuss Underline 1.5.87 build on the same SDK4.0ba.7.24_SAB_20130620 codebase and 0x99xx remote coding; silences UART TX via a dummy printf stub and checks an external anti-clone crypto chip at I2C 0x10 at startup.
